card.description: A slider with two handles that sets a lower and an upper number, date, or time entity.

helper.entity_low: The handle for the lower value sets this entity.
helper.entity_high: The handle for the upper value sets this entity.
helper.min: Leave empty for the default. Times like 06:00, dates like 2026-10-01 or +7d.
helper.max: Leave empty for the default. Times like 22:00, dates like 2026-12-31 or +30d.
helper.step: Leave empty for the default. For times in minutes, for dates in days.
helper.unit: For numbers. Leave empty to use the entity's own unit.
helper.position: By default numbers show next to the slider, dates and times below it.
helper.full_width: The slider also uses the space next to it. Values next to the slider move below it.
helper.small: Shows the values in smaller text.
helper.push: When off, a handle stops at the other handle.

warning.bad_range: The lowest value on the slider must be below the highest value.
warning.bad_limit: The lowest or highest value on the slider is not a valid date or time.
warning.mixed_kinds: Both entities must hold the same kind of value: numbers, times, dates, or dates with times.
